notes.title: After a long break in game development
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27616434/1b5a24a7c4f0ce235a2813370c55eb29217287c3.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, Friends![/h1]
After a long break in game development, 
we continue to preparing campaigns for the full release. 
We apologize for this long pause. 
Follow up the announcements!

P.s.: Thanks for your patience, Guys.
__
[i]All the best :newquest:
Dragon's Games[/i]

notes.title: Campaign / Battleground
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27616434/71f4e73e1f049a2acd52d1d54aefb6e99832dc26.png[/img]

Hello friends!

We are a small team with limited resources, so everything moves a bit slower than we would like. But we are working on a campaign that is scheduled for the next few months and will make a significant update on the existing battlegrounds. We want to get out from the early access with a decent game considering your feedback. Thank you all for your patience.

If you don't want to miss any future news follow us on Twitter, Facebook etc.

notes.title: Thanks everybody who joined us in this Tyranic journey!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27616434/57574a26d868bab93e4e98e52cb73bdc31ff95ad.png[/img]
[h1]List of changes in this update:[/h1]
    [*]Optimized game spells. Improved spell perfomance for big battles.
    [*]Unit selections. Now you can attach whole unit group by taping on single unit.
    [*]You're getting gold for killing neutral units. Killing mobs now make sence.
    [*]We've optimized camera Post FX and now you can turn it off in the game settings.
    [*]We've fixed a problem with save data erasure after update. 
    [*]Also we've improved game balance and fixed some minor bugs.

We're curently working on the new PvP map and campaign ːnewquestː
Also we'll add Steam cloud support and transfer save data there.
